title: Negative of cigar-shaped craft sketch with windows and flame on Henry Grady Hotel paper
description: Photostat negative of a signed hand sketch on Henry Grady Hotel stationery showing a wingless cigar-shaped craft with two rows of rectangular "LARGE WINDOWS OR OPENINGS" (one marked "LIGHTED") and a body marked "BLACK". Labels include "ORANGE & RED FLAME 40' LONG" at the tail, "100' LENGTH", and "NO FINS"; a circle at lower left is captioned "ESTIMATED FRONT VIEW - ROUND".
